verdict.rationale: The evidence pack scopes this product as the Gemini consumer app, and all first-party docs describe UI, voice and desktop interaction only, with no documented public API for driving the app. The probe found no agent-docs or MCP discovery surface on gemini.google.com and states that the Gemini developer API is a separate product on ai.google.dev. Community mentions of API pricing and AI Studio settings refer to that separate model API, so they are not credited here.
